title: Monthly and seasonal hazard timeseries by admin unit
description: Monthly and rolling 3-month hazard means by admin unit, with anomalies against the 1995-2014 baseline, ensemble spread and trend statistics. Drives the notebooks' Future Projections view.
gaps: Its CDH record is still at schema v0.0.1 with no data block, while every other record is v0.3.0.
